comparison.objective: Bimanually pour a simulated molten charge into the dry mould, versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-handle lifting, carrying, tipping, and hazard selection differ from fine hex access, captive-screw torque, collar setting, and iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Success requires at least 90% of beads in the dry mould, limited spill, safe set-down, and no hot-crucible grasp; the candidate requires two force/travel-bounded stops with the setting locked.
comparison.reason: The board spec is complete and tests coordinated bulk pouring and mould selection, not adjustable mechanism servicing.
